questions.stem_text:
If a monopsony labor market suddenly were transformed into a perfectly competitive labor
market, how would the wage and employment change?

options.A: The wage would decrease, but employment would remain constant.
options.D: The wage would remain constant, but employment would increase.
options.E: The wage would increase, but employment would remain constant.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - Both would increase.

options.A: a monopsony competes with a monopoly
options.B: a monopsony buys from a monopoly
options.C: a monopolist sells two different types of goods
options.D: two monopolies sell to a single consumer
options.E: a monopoly competes with a monopsony

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - a monopsony buys from a monopoly

questions.stem_text:
What is meant by "economic resources" or "factorsof production"? Name three categories of
resources.

options.B: raw materials, human resources and technology
options.C: natural resources, artificial resources and human resources
options.E: Intellectual property, workforce, and real estate

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Capital, commodities, and currency

questions.stem_text:
Which of the following is NOT a feature of continuously compounded returns (i.e. log-
returns)?

options.A: They can be interpreted as continuously compounded changes in the prices
options.B: They can be added over time to give returns for longer time periods
options.C: They can be added across a portfolio of assets to give portfolio returns

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - They can be added across a portfolio of assets to give portfolio returns

questions.stem_text:
Suppose transfer payments are greater than Social Security contributions corporate taxes
and retained earnings combined. In that case

options.A: NDP will be greater than GDP.
options.B: NI will be greater than GDP.
options.C: PI will be greater than NI.
options.D: DPI will be greater than PI.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - PI will be greater than NI.
